svg.title: Physical ESP32-S3 N16R8 board to L298N car wiring
svg.desc: Your actual board photograph, component side facing you, antenna up and USB down. GPIO1 to IN1, GPIO14 to IN2, GPIO21 to IN3, GPIO47 to IN4, GPIO41 to ENA and GPIO42 to ENB. Motors on OUT1/2 and OUT3/4. Separate regulated 5V logic and existing 5V motor supply, common ground. Remove ENA, ENB and 5V-EN jumpers. Photograph pin locations are marked directly.
svg.text: ESP32-S3 N16R8 + L298N / physical connection diagram
Same wiring-guide format as the classic ESP32 project • this board uses different GPIO pins
Antenna UP • USB DOWN • count header pads from the top
Module drawing shows terminal names; check your module labels
No motor output is permanent GND
Never connect 5 V to any ESP GPIO.
VS uses your 5 V supply, despite its “+12V” label.
One USB cable; do not also feed the 5V header.
COMMON GROUND: ESP GND + L298N GND + USB supply negative + motor supply negative
Dots mark joined wires. Crossings without dots are not electrical connections. Route motor current through power wiring.
PHYSICAL HEADER POSITIONS — look at the front, antenna up
OV3660 plugs into the ribbon socket. The board photo is yours; L298N terminal placement is schematic. GPIO mapping matches the S3 firmware.
